data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 便利店热咖啡
data.description: 【雪之下雪乃 · 便利店热咖啡】清晨薄雾未散的校道旁，雪乃从便利店走出，双手捧着冒着热气的纸杯咖啡。她转过身将另一杯热拿铁递到你面前，视线微微游移——「路过时顺手多买了一杯。黑咖啡太苦不适合你，所以给你选了加糖拿铁……别多想，只是顺便而已。」
data.action: 走出便利店后，一手拿自己的纸杯咖啡，另一手将另一杯拿铁递给同行者
data.promptProse: Outside the convenience store, Yukino holds her own coffee in her left hand and offers a warm latte with her right, both cups upright beneath a reserved sideways smile. White shirt and long casual coat sit below black hair along the collar. The medium view follows the misty school route beyond the entrance. Clear morning light brightens cup lids and her offered fingers, while the entrance canopy softly shades the nearer coat folds.
